# InfraLicence

> InfraLicence Consultants & Solutions provides Karnataka-focused licensing, contractor registration, and compliance support services.

Canonical: https://infralicence.in/

## Summary

- Primary focus: KPWD contractor registration and licensing support
- Secondary services: CPWD registration, electrical licence, MSME, GST, DSC, GeM
- Audience: contractors, civil engineers, firms, LLPs, and private limited companies
- Geography: Karnataka, India

## Main Pages

- Home: https://infralicence.in/
- About: https://infralicence.in/about
- Contact: https://infralicence.in/contact
- Services: https://infralicence.in/services
